title: Strict Inclusion of Tree Size Classes
statement: Let $T,T',\ell:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ and let $n_0\in\mathbb N$. Suppose that $\ell(n)\le n$ and $T(n)\le T'(n)$ for every $n$, that $2^{\ell(n)}(\ell(n)+1)+1\le T'(n)$ for every $n$, and that $(\ell(n_0)+4)T(n_0)<2^{\ell(n_0)}$. Then the class of Boolean languages recognizable by circuit-tree families of size at most $T(n)$ on inputs of length $n$ is a proper subset of the corresponding class with size bound $T'(n)$.
